name: Cyberpunk
description: Black ground, magenta and acid green, and a terminal face.
bestFor: Night interfaces that should feel like a rainy alley terminal.
promptFragment: Visual style: Cyberpunk. Use a black ground, magenta and cyan neon edges, an acid-green action color, and a monospace face. Corners are square. Shadows are glows, not soft daylight. Avoid pastel paper, serif editorial type, and large airy radii. Keep text readable: meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (4.5:1) against the surface the text actually sits on. https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html
